text:
anna: quick RFC follow-up: propose "intent" tags on API keys (small set) + an exchange endpoint for short-lived delegation tokens for cross-project ops. thoughts?
jon: sounds promising. how do we check intents without DB on the hot path?
anna: encode a compact intent bitmap in key metadata cached in gateway memory; use pub/sub for invalidation.
priya: make sure RBAC remains authoritative downstream. intents only route/limit, not grant resource perms.
jon: migration? existing project-scoped keys must keep working.
anna: dual-mode: accept legacy keys and map them to inferred intents for 6 months, encourage new intent-first keys.
priya: revocation? derived tokens must be revocable.
anna: short TTLs + revocation stream by key_id, gateways keep a local revoked set.
auth-bot: feature-flag "intent-exchange" created in staging. enable with ff-rollout when ready. :package:
